profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: A passionate developer who prides themselves in solving complex problems in elegant ways.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead Engineer on the Account Me Out team in the core modernization space.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer on team Account Me Out in the Core Modernization space.  Working on modernization solutions for all of Card's products.

• Worked towards building a modern core for handling credit card accounts internally.
• Led initiative for implementing ELM and Morphir code into internal pipeline solution.
• Led initiative for attribute mapping discovery including a POC written in GO and providing a working solution to deploy all the code.
• Led multiple proof of concept works to discover how historical transaction loading and account closure could work in the new core.
• Created GoLang and TypeScript CLIs for packing and deploying projects for our internal account representations.
• Contributed to Morphir Open Source projects

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full time developer on team Stream Lords that owns a spark streaming library used across multiple different implementations as well as other spark streaming applications that handles critical customer and transaction data.

• Developer on Spark Streaming library used across 5+ different systems that enables consumers to focus on transformations, while the library can be easily configured for reading and writing to data sources
• Developed system to pre-load dynamo database with millions of records in minutes
• Developed solution with IBM MQ and spark to stream and transform messages up to 500 TPS with full automated resiliency

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full time developer on Team Market masters in the Finance tech space within Capital One, focusing on the development of data pipelines bringing in critical information to our financial businesses.

• Oversaw platform health of 6+ Lambdas, Step Functions, and DynamoDB.
• Stabilized platform health through Jenkins pipeline, testing automation, and package remediations
• Led initiatives bringing in new data types from the Bloomberg vendor, new columns into daily datasets, and more ticker information into daily pulls.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full time developer on Team Cheetahs and Cybernauts in the Branded Book, Customer Resiliency space.  Quickly familiarized myself with customer resiliency and the post charge-off space in Omega

• Helped design and implement Debt Settlement Payments modernization using Spring Batch framework combined with AWS
• Followed agile development strategy while on teams
• Contributed to other services and shared libraries in Omega ecosystem
• Owned DSG notes upload process
• Contributed in remediation effort to automatically identify and update any out of date Security Groups on infrastructure
• Promoted within first year in role
• Contributed to IAM role remediation efforts to standardize roles across Customer Resiliency
• Frontend DSG SIF modernization.
• Design and creation of new DSG micro service for DSG Letter and Naming modernizations.
• Contributed to front end and back end changes for DSG Letter modernization.
• Followed Agile delivery practices when delivering solutions.

positions.title: Digital Technology Intern
positions.description:
•	Developer on Identity Management team; solved recurring operational problems which freed operational resources to work on more complex problems
•	Participated in Kanban team, along with daily standups.
•	Developed read-only debug page plugin for SailPoint system.
•	Developed export-only application entitlement plugin for SailPoint system
•	Added functionality to a self-manage portal to allow end user to directly update information on their application
•	Migrated data, and updated system to restore original purpose of systems design, while keeping the extra functionality available to end user.
•	Modified ant build scripts to safely import xml artifacts on build even if an import fails.

positions.title: Ditigal Technology Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked on developing a business intelligence application using SiSense for GE’s Identity Management System
•	Created functioning BI tool that looks at the operations level of IDM, that uses series, trends, and analytics to proactively identify problems within the system
•	Developed ruby app to integrate Github and Rally workspaces across multiple Github repositories.
•	Developed database report procedure that sent an email every 4 hours with a report of the entire database
•	Created a database monitoring system that alerts the team when certain issues arose within the database
•	“Massaged” data when necessary for better use within the BI tool
•	Worked with XML and extracting values from XML
•	BI tool helped increase performance within IDM, which, in turn, yielded a greater customer satisfaction
•	Increased productivity for operational resources, which reduced product cost for IDM

positions.title: Jr. Field Sales Leader
positions.description:
• Total Career Sales: $26,000
• 5 promotions in three months.  "Key Staff" promotion within first month.
• Number 2 new representative in Kentucky-Tennessee-Southern Ohio division, and 4th best representative in the Eastern Cincinnati office for summer campaign.
• Top 20 sales representatives in Mid-West region for Conference of Champions sales campaign.
• "Most Impressive Representative" award in the Kentucky-Tennessee-Southern Ohio region for the summer campaign
• Member of "The Leadership Academy"; learned how to run interviews, run training sessions, and manage new representatives; ran first interview January 2017

positions.title: Logistics Assistant
positions.description:
• Managed logistics preparation
• Assisted loading new operating systems on all products

honors.title: Deans List Spring 2018
honors.description:
Within the top 20% of undergraduates within their division.
